description: For one target of the draft, where each of the person's fields comes from: sure (with a proposal), choose (with candidates) or unknown. Turn each sure item into a mapping for save_draft: a proposal of kind "map" becomes {"target", "source"} with its where, value_map or classify; kind "direct" becomes {"target", "source": null}. Ask the person about the ones marked choose and unknown. linked, when present: fields to suggest to the person for their own schema, where one of their fields is filled from a value of ours that has the document's own words beside it (a limit that is not one amount, a construction read as "mixed"); each says the field to add and the mapping that fills it. Suggest it; adding it is their decision.

workflow.description: The workflow's id (wf_…) or its slug, from list_workflows.

title: Map a target's fields
